name: A.R.M. Holding
note: Dubai-based investment group describing itself as 'a UAE-based private investment and real estate company' (armholding.ae). Its portfolio includes HUNA (per hunaliving.ae, 'A Subsidiary of A.R.M. Holding') and Dubai Real Estate Centre (per drec.ae and ARM Holding's own site). Its beneficial owners are not published on its site. Its CEO, H.E. Mohammad Saeed Al Shehhi, is also Secretary-General of the UAE National Media Authority and Director of the Board and General Manager of the Emirates Racing Authority, per the leadership section of armholding.ae.
